statement_blocker: The catalog slogan does not select the GMR zero-knowledge definition, GMR Theorem 1 for quadratic residuosity, GMR Theorem 2 for quadratic nonresiduosity, the later GMW conditional NP theorem, or another protocol result. It omits the language, proof/argument and interaction model, adversary and simulator classes, auxiliary input and view, indistinguishability notion, security and complexity parameters, completeness/soundness contract, ordered binders, exact conclusion, and boundary cases. Selecting a familiar formulation would invent or substitute mathematics.
